title: Hand-plotted graph: Slant Range in Feet vs MPH, assuming 21°/sec angular velocity
description: Pencil graph on Keuffel & Esser 10x10-to-the-inch graph paper plotting slant range (vertical axis, up to about 10,000 feet) against speed in MPH (horizontal axis, 0 to about 300). Two straight lines rise from the origin, one annotated "10% error." A handwritten note reads "Slant Range in feet vs MPH, Assuming 21°/sec angular velocity."
